QUOTE: ret & 0xFF80 (high-level part, module) ──► mbedtls_high_level_strerr(ret) ... ret & ~0xFF80 (low-level part) ──► mbedtls_low_level_strerr(ret) ... both present → join with " : " (only if ≥5 bytes remain), then append low-level text
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer describes the two-layer code (high-level module part and low-level part) and that mbedtls_strerror joins both texts when both are present.
